[WEX](http://wex/) **®** announced it has been recognized with three[2026 MarCom Awards](https://marcomawards.com/) , including a Platinum honor, for social media and influencer programs across its Mobility and Benefits businesses. The winners of the prestigious international creative competition were announced October 30, 2026.


The MarCom Awards, administered by the Association of Marketing and Communication Professionals (AMCP), honors outstanding achievement by marketing and communication professionals in the concept, direction, design, and production of marketing programs and materials. This year’s competition drew more than 6,000 entries from the United States, Canada, and 40 other countries across more than 300 categories.


Headquartered in Portland, Maine, WEX received the following awards:


- **Platinum Award – Turning Trust into Traction (Influencer Content Category):** Recognizing the 10-4 by WEX® campaign, which successfully engaged the owner-operator trucking community through genuine creator collaborations. Featuring a presence at the Mid-America Trucking Show alongside partnerships with influential social media figures such as[Alex Nino](https://www.instagram.com/p/DYi6eS0sDOj/) ,[Oscar the Trucker](https://www.instagram.com/p/DOoO-m-iYFS/) , and[Juanito Cardenas](https://www.instagram.com/p/DXPn1nyD-Jr/) (@TruckingDept), the initiative connected with a traditionally skeptical audience. The program yielded higher application downloads at a lower cost-per-install, alongside significant follower acquisition surrounding National Truck Driver Appreciation Week.
- **Gold Award – Creative That Meets the Moment (Social Media Campaign Category):** Honoring strategic campaign alignment with key seasonal events and real-time operational demands facing fleet card clients. By connecting marketing touchpoints with fluctuating fuel prices, summer travel surges, and holiday commerce, the digital strategy enhanced paid social efficiency, reducing cost-per-lead while advancing new account acquisition.
- **Honorable Mention – National Health Savings Account Day:** Highlighting the 2025[HSA Day initiative](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/hsa-day-ugcPost-7381041814142832640-StYG/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAC6w9LcBTOago6NywWG5THob5TzpzHOeSXg) , which illustrated how consumers leverage health savings accounts to enhance personal health and long-term financial stability. The effort established several milestones for the line of business, including an initial co-branded promotional sweepstakes with HSA Store®, combined B2B and B2C creator activations, and targeted paid promotion, generating record digital engagement for the event.


“Social media is where brands earn attention one post at a time, and name recognition doesn’t guarantee it. We’ve built trust through relevance, authenticity, and understanding our audiences better than anyone,” said Amy Kellinger, senior vice president, revenue marketing. “Earning MarCom Awards in a competition that includes some of the biggest names in marketing shows that great social strategy can level the playing field. It reflects our progress in making social a real driver of business results.”


WEX collaborated with paid social agency[NP Digital](https://npdigital.com/) on the recognized campaigns, campaign and influencer agency[The Social Standard](https://www.sostandard.com/) on the “Turning Trust into Action” and “National Health Savings Account Day” entrees, and creative agency[Superside](https://www.superside.com/) on the “Creative That Meets the Moment” entry. The award-winning output spans audiences as different as owner-operator truckers on the road and individuals managing their health savings, each calling for its own approach and tone.


“Standing out on social media takes more than good content. It requires being bold enough to stop the scroll and meaningful enough to resonate with people once it does,” said Audrey Gagne, digital marketing director at WEX. “Being recognized by MarCom in such a strong field of applicants is a testament to our team’s creativity and willingness to take risks.”


## **About NP Digital**


NP Digital combines proprietary technology, AI, and creative capabilities to help ambitious brands grow through connected strategy and execution. A global, award-winning digital marketing agency serving enterprise and mid-market organizations, they bring expertise across earned, paid, and owned media to build standout visibility and brand experiences.


## **About The Social Standard**


The Social Standard is an award-winning, full-service influencer marketing agency based in Nashville, Tennessee. Founded in 2013, the agency has spent more than a decade ahead of the curve, running the first Instagram Story creator ads, launching B2B influencer programs on LinkedIn and building podcast creator partnerships years before mass adoption. Long-standing clients include Adobe, Hinge, Seiko and Fiat Chrysler. If you’re ready to set the standard, learn more at[sostandard.com](http://sostandard.com/) .


## **About Superside**


Superside is the world’s leading AI-first creative partner, helping brands like Intuit, Amazon, DoorDash, Figma, and Reddit scale high-performing creative. Superside is the creative service where enterprise teams get the top 1% of global talent, powered by AI, plugged directly into their workflows.
